name.description: Must equal the skill folder name and the SKILL.md frontmatter name.

kind.description: recipe: two or more products in one scenario, with a seams guide. skill: one capability the core repo does not cover.

products.description: UiPath products the skill touches. A recipe lists at least two.

tier.description: Every skill enters as community. Only a steward sets verified.

cli_version.description: The @uipath/cli version the skill was written against, e.g. 1.207.0.

last_verified.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the last end-to-end run. Required when tier is verified.

upstream.description: Set when the skill is maintained in another repo and mirrored here.
